metric_arithmetic.accuracy: correct_Final / all_fixed_recordings, computed separately per panel then equal-panel mean
metric_arithmetic.fixed_macro_f1: mean over all60 classes of 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero denominator maps to0
metric_arithmetic.macro_recall: mean TP/support over gold-supported classes only; absent-class recall=null; disclose supported-class count
metric_arithmetic.source_equal_accuracy: mean over source groups of within-group recording accuracy, separately per panel then equal-panel mean
metric_arithmetic.invalid: missing or noncanonical prediction is wrong and contributes one gold-class FN; never fabricated FP for another class

metric_arithmetic.valid_prediction: typed boolean only; strings and integer0/1 are invalid; aliases must be decoded by frozen parser before this boundary
metric_arithmetic.positive_recall: TP / all admitted positives; invalid positive contributes FN
metric_arithmetic.false_positive_rate: FP / all admitted negatives including invalid negatives; null if no admitted negatives
metric_arithmetic.negative_failure_rate: (FP + invalid_negative) / all admitted negatives; must accompany FPR
metric_arithmetic.specificity: TN / all admitted negatives; invalid negative is not TN
metric_arithmetic.balanced_accuracy: 0.5*(positive_recall+specificity); null unless both admitted polarities supported
metric_arithmetic.positive_f1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero denominator0 only if at least one admitted label; no admitted labels=null
metric_arithmetic.macro_positive_f1: equal definition mean within I_present and S_present separately over fixed admitted-positive-supported definitions; report denominator and IDs; no cross-family pooled headline
metric_arithmetic.aggregation: each definition occurs in one canonical panel; pool recordings for that definition, then macro over definitions, not mean of ragged-panel macro scores
metric_arithmetic.validity: report all-coordinate invalid rate and admitted-coordinate invalid rate separately; absence of predictions never changes coverage

metric_arithmetic.complete_population: fixed per-panel recordings with every configured S_present truth positive or negative; independent of predictions
metric_arithmetic.em: all configured typed answers valid and equal truth; missing or invalid answer makes row wrong
metric_arithmetic.micro_f1: sum TP/FP/FN across configured types and complete rows before computing F1; all-zero denominator0 if complete rows exist, otherwise null
metric_arithmetic.macro_f1: equal mean of per-type positive F1 on complete rows for types with admitted positive support there; no positive-supported types=null
metric_arithmetic.empty_gold_set: nonempty slot schema with all-negative truth is an ordinary complete row; all-false valid output gets EM1, invalid output EM0
metric_arithmetic.no_slot_panel: schema with zero S_present questions is N/A, never perfect empty-set result
metric_arithmetic.aggregation: publish each panel and its complete coverage/support; no pooled55-type set score or undefined-panel imputation
metric_arithmetic.partial_truth: only per-decision masked metrics, no complete-set EM/F1 contribution

prediction_ledger_contract.population: exact frozen request schedule; no extra, duplicate or mismatched coordinates
prediction_ledger_contract.completion: every request must have an authenticated terminal completed or failed receipt; missing/pending is an incomplete run, never fabricated failure or silently skipped
prediction_ledger_contract.failed_request: explicit error and raw backend or transport evidence required; all configured outputs invalid even if partial output exists
prediction_ledger_contract.completed_invalid_output: receipt remains in denominator; completed does not imply valid or correct
prediction_ledger_contract.raw_parser: freeze version; reject duplicate JSON keys and ambiguous raw envelopes before building a map; preserve raw bytes and hash
prediction_ledger_contract.span_mapping: use registered arm/panel/transform positions and output_symbol maps; no label-name guessing, integer/bool coercion or cross-namespace interpretation
prediction_ledger_contract.partial_span_map: missing or invalid registered symbol invalidates that node; other valid nodes remain scoreable; schema-level unknown positions or non-map invalidates all nodes
prediction_ledger_contract.direct: only registered Final position; no process coordinates fabricated from native Final
prediction_ledger_contract.supervision: prediction coverage independent of semantic masks; native Final remains scored for all fixed recordings
prediction_ledger_contract.integrity: production reader must bind raw evidence to model/checkpoint, task, input/audio, registered readout and final metric protocol hashes; reference helper does not authenticate these
